info.title: loophole tape
info.description: Live pump.fun / PumpSwap analytics derived from public on-chain data. Pay per request in USDC on Solana through x402. See the documented routes for coverage and freshness.
info.x-guidance: Machine-payable pump.fun intelligence. Call /v1/x402/resources or /llms.txt first. Paid GET routes return 402 with the x402 v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (and the same JSON in the body); pay USDC on Solana mainnet (exact scheme, PayAI facilitator) and retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. Every response is {ok, schema_version, generated_at, coverage: full|thin, data, meta{feed_lag_s, is_stale, next}}. Free: /v1/market/regime, /v1/sample/*, /health, /v1/labels. MCP at /mcp.

get.description: Risk card for ONE pump.fun mint, always HTTP 200 for a valid base58 mint. coverage=full when the mint is in our live window: curve truth (graduation = curve witnessed >= 84 SOL), demand (unique buyers, buys/sells 60 s, net SOL), holder concentration (top-5, HHI), create-slot bundle / insider / dev shares, look-ahead-safe creator prior at launch, warm-launch (observed creator-funding links) label, rug/close flags with first-seen times, exit signals. coverage=thin otherwise: our resolved launch record if any + current bonding-curve state from RPC + creator prior. Every card carries status, risk_label, confidence, a why[] list and market base rates. Nulls carry a reason; nothing is guessed.

get.description: Recent Pons V2 launches on Robinhood Chain (chain 4663; default last hour, newest first) as compact structure cards computed from observed on-chain activity: raised (ETH), progress to the 4.2 ETH graduation, price multiple vs launch, snipe-tax activity, holder concentration (top-1 / top-5 / HHI), same-block direct-buy cluster share (matching timing, not proof of coordination), terminal-vs-direct route mix with the terminal router transactions joined to their wallets, inflow (new buyers in the last 2 / 6 s), lifecycle (live / complete / graduated). Filter pair=eth for ETH-paired curves, min_buys to skip dead launches.

get.description: Full structure card for ONE Pons V2 curve on Robinhood Chain, addressed by curve or token address (0x…): launch facts (block, deployer, pair token, graduation threshold), raised / progress / price multiple vs launch (ETH-paired curves), snipe-tax activity, holder ledger concentration (top-1 / top-5 / HHI / deployer share), same-block direct-buy cluster share and wallets, max direct buys in one 100 ms block, terminal-vs-direct route mix with terminal holdings share, flow (buys / sells / unique buyers / new buyers in the last 2 and 6 s / last trade age / volumes), lifecycle (completed / graduated blocks and delays, refunds). coverage=full for curves launched inside our event window (last ~2 h, trades observed from block 0); thin = launch facts + lifecycle only, with a reason. Always 200 for a valid address.
